name: Original Mindfuck Animation
source:
Dr. Neuroflay's finally done it: she's found the specimen of her desires to conduct long-awaited research. The brain and nerves of the physics-warping magical girl, Graviko, are guaranteed to hold the universe's deepest secrets, at least according to the mad scientist. What distorted fruit will Neuroflay's efforts bear?

[From [url=https://hyp-hyp-hooray.itch.io/oma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Neuroflay博士终于做到了：她找到了她渴望进行期待已久的研究的样本。至少根据这位疯狂科学家的说法，扭曲物理的魔法女孩格拉维科的大脑和神经肯定掌握着宇宙最深的秘密。Neuroflay的努力会带来什么扭曲的成果？

[来自[url=https://hyp-hyp-hooray.itch.io/oma]itch.io[/url]]
